pr_body:
Fixing MvAppendTests CB exceptions by generating smaller geometries: the test generates a lot of documents and the CB is too small for multiple big shapes.

Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/109409
pr_title: ES|QL: reduce memory footprint for MvAppendTests with shapes
pr_comment: Thanks @craigtaverner, I refactored the tests following your suggestions, now it looks much better

review_comment: It would be nice to move this to a utility class for use in other tests.
It would be nice to move this to a utility class for use in other tests.
